stateOwner: one serial decode executor coordinates one persistent WASAPI device worker

invariants.replacement: open and prebuffer a candidate reader before installing an exact newer device generation; a caller may require that exact generation before preparation
invariants.failedReplacement: candidate open or decode failure preserves the active reader, generation, pending block, and device stream
invariants.candidateCancellation: a lifecycle command or a stop token bound to an exact-generation command cancels bounded candidate prebuffer work before the generation commit point
invariants.failureTeardown: decode, handoff, and EOS failures discard the active generation before publishing its terminal receipt
invariants.handoff: retain one decoded block until the device worker accepts it; cancellation retracts an unadmitted handoff
invariants.generationBarrier: Stop, Reset, device queue clear, and stale handoff refusal complete before replacement acknowledgement
invariants.sampleDomain: source samples and time bases remain contiguous and stable across merged blocks, then rebase to a checked nonnegative stream-relative output cursor only after the first block is admitted
invariants.endOfStream: ordered EOS carries the exact final output sample and terminal completion waits for endpoint padding drain
invariants.clock: successful Start returns a generation-matched device clock anchor for the requested timeline frame and preserves the first admitted source presentation timestamp and time base
invariants.position: a generation-checked read returns only a cached non-regressing device-thread clock sample and preserves terminal state and failure
invariants.transport: pause and resume preserve the exact generation, clock anchor, queued PCM, decoded cursor, and source mapping; repeated controls are no-ops and stale generations are refused
invariants.pausedSeekPreparation: an exact newer generation may prebuffer and prime source-aligned PCM without starting the device or publishing a clock anchor; the first Resume starts that generation and establishes its source-aware timeline clock anchor
invariants.close: an active generation receives a separate cancellation terminal before device close; concurrent close joins once

excluded: gapless replacement while candidate open or decode is slow
continuous scrub, speed change, and time stretch
A/V frame selection and drift correction
